Inbound Email.description: Trigger initiates from an email that is sent to your instance. You can configure the trigger to determine which emails start your flow. Select a “Target Table” to qualify replies or forwards from record notifications. For example, to trigger a flow from a Reply or Forward email that a user sends from an incident record notification, select the Incident [incident] table as the target table.
